title: Choose a principle for each feedback talk
context: You lead a small team and give each person feedback one on one.
question: Which principle should you apply now?

principles.name: Name the behaviour
principles.rule: The facts are not agreed yet. Say what you saw or heard, without a judgement.

principles.name: Ask an open question
principles.rule: The facts are agreed, but the cause is not known. Ask what got in the way.

principles.name: Agree on the next action
principles.rule: You both know the cause. Agree on who does what, and when you will follow up.

cases.text: Sam agrees the last two handover notes did not say who owns each task, and you have both traced it to a new template that hides that field. You are about to ask, "So what will you change?"
cases.looksLike: Your line is a question, so it can look like Ask an open question.
cases.decides: Sam accepts the facts and you both know the cause, so asking what will change is right. Agree on who changes the template and when you'll follow up.

cases.text: Jo says, "I didn't interrupt anyone in Monday's meeting." You are about to reply, "From now on, let people finish."
cases.looksLike: "From now on" sounds like Agree on the next action.
cases.decides: Jo disputes what happened, so the facts are not agreed. Say what you saw: who was speaking, and when Jo started talking.

cases.text: Alex agrees they talked over Priya twice in Monday's meeting, says "I'm not sure why," and offers to wait until others finish next time.
cases.looksLike: Alex's offer sounds like Agree on the next action.
cases.decides: The facts are agreed, but nobody knows why, so the offer may not stop it next time. Ask what was going on.

cases.text: Maya's last two handover notes did not say who owns each task, and you have not raised it yet. Your planned first line is "Why don't you care about handovers?"
cases.looksLike: Your line is a question, so it can look like Ask an open question.
cases.decides: Nothing has been raised, so the facts are not agreed, and "don't care" is a judgement. Start with what you saw: neither note said who owns each task.
